note: THE PLAN ITSELF, cited for what it says of itself: that the Commercial Club published it in 1909, prepared by Burnham and Bennett, and that it held the lake front to belong to the people. Used for one time-stream caption, a fact about a year the arrival passes through on the way to 1904; nothing in any scene is built from it, and it describes no building of the 1904 grid.
what_it_supplies: that the Plan of Chicago was published in 1909 by the Commercial Club, prepared by Daniel H. Burnham and Edward H. Bennett
